screens.name: Welcome
screens.purpose: A0 · The screen before everything, for someone who arrives from a WhatsApp link knowing nothing. Three plain steps, then three doors, because the three people who land here want different things: a cook, a voter, and someone who knows a cook. Each door says what you do and what you get. Free, no app, two minutes, stated on the screen because those are the three unasked questions.
screens.entry_point: the WhatsApp invite link lands here

screens.name: TBKHTY home
screens.purpose: A1 · The entry point, above any single club. The topline ranking of the best cooks across all five editions with its area and dish filters, then the competitions themselves, soonest to close first, so nothing assumes which club you belong to.

links.label: Sign up as a cook to compete
New here? How the competition works

screens.name: Club edition home
screens.purpose: A2 · One edition, reached from the home screen. Two taps to everything: vote or enter. Countdown to voting close and to the tasting, live top 3, social proof, and the other live editions along the bottom.

screens.name: How the competition works
screens.purpose: A3 · How the competition works. Three illustrated steps for cooks, three for voters, the 40/30/30 scoring split with judges sealed until the ceremony, and the prizes.

links.label: Sign up as a cook to compete
Just here to vote? Start voting

screens.name: Show Cairo your cooking
screens.purpose: B1 · Why enter. Prizes, neighbours tasting her food, first access when orders open. One CTA, plus a WhatsApp route for cooks who would rather be helped through it.

links.label: Prefer help? Send us your entry on WhatsApp

screens.name: Verify your number
screens.purpose: B2 · Verify. WhatsApp number, 4-digit code, and a consent line written in plain words. Step 1 of 4.

screens.name: About you and your area
screens.purpose: B3 · About you. Club is already known from the invite link, so the taps go on location instead: one GPS button, or one tap on an area chip showing its distance from the club. Photo stays optional.

screens.name: Area picker
screens.purpose: B3a · Area picker. The full drill-down: governorate chips, then the areas inside it, and a compounds level where one exists. Search across the whole list, and an escape hatch for anything missing. Distance to the club is computed in the backend, never shown here.

screens.name: Drop your pin
screens.purpose: B3b · The pin itself. GPS centres the map, she drags to her building, and the coordinate is only stored when she confirms. The line under the address is the one thing the pin is for: how far she is from the club, computed in the backend.

screens.name: Your area and club
screens.purpose: B3d · Step 3 of 5. Split out of B3, which was holding a map, two required selects, a club select and an explainer in one step. The pin's reading is confirmed at the top, then governorate, area and the optional club, and the teal card shows the consequence live: the two rankings these answers just entered you into, with a link to how the two tracks work.

links.label: Browse the full list or add a compound

screens.name: Your signature dish
screens.purpose: B4 · Signature dish. Dish name, one photo with three shooting tips, a two-line story and one category chip. This is the screen that produces the feed post.

screens.name: Entry preview
screens.purpose: B5 · Preview. The entry rendered exactly as voters will see it, so nothing is a surprise. Confirm or go back and edit.

screens.name: You're in
screens.purpose: B6 · Celebration. Competitor number, confetti, and the share card as the primary action while she is still excited. The dashboard is the quiet second option.

screens.name: Nominate a cook
screens.purpose: C1 · Nominate. The prize ladder comes first, because 'nominate a cook' on its own gives a voter no reason to tap. Then five fields, and a WhatsApp invite carrying the nominator's name, which is what makes it get opened.

screens.name: Nomination received
screens.purpose: C2 · What she sees. Three neighbours, in their own words, the fact that they win if she reaches the top 3, then straight into a pre-filled version of Flow B starting at verification.
screens.entry_point: the nomination WhatsApp message lands here

screens.name: My nominations
screens.purpose: C3 · The nominator's tracker. The cooks she found, how far each has got, the rung that unlocks next and a nudge to share the one who is closest. Reached from the gift icon on A1, A2 and her supporter profile.

screens.name: My entry dashboard
screens.purpose: D1 · Dashboard. Rank with movement, total votes, votes today, countdown, the close-race nudge, the milestone bar and the supporters who brought the votes.

links.label: Share now to close the gap

screens.name: Share card generator
screens.purpose: D2 · Share card. The 9:16 story image she actually posts, with four one-tap destinations and the credit line from her last share.

screens.name: Kitchen readiness
screens.purpose: D3 · Kitchen readiness. Delivery radius is now the live card, anchored on the area she gave at signup, so location turns into a reachable zone. Seven questions, one card at a time, each answer paying out a small unlock.

screens.name: Tasting day checklist
screens.purpose: D4 · Tasting day. Table number, arrival time, what to bring, the rule that the dish must match the entry photo, and the map inside the club.

screens.name: Browse entries
screens.purpose: E1 · Feed. Entries as social posts under a sticky countdown, with category filters. The vote button sits where a like button would.

screens.name: Entry detail
screens.purpose: E2 · Cook page. An early creator profile: vote, follow with the kitchen-opens promise, order intent with price chips, and her other dishes.

screens.name: Verify to vote
screens.purpose: E3 · Verify to vote. Same two required location steps as the cook side, compressed into the sheet: location confirmed, then governorate and area side by side. Club stays optional underneath.

screens.name: Vote confirmed
screens.purpose: E4 · Confirmed. Rank movement, the streak starting, share as the primary action and the raffle questions as the optional one.

screens.name: Quick profile
screens.purpose: E5 · Quick profile. Area is already saved from E3 and shown as confirmed context rather than asked twice. Three chip questions, paid for with a raffle entry.

screens.name: Already voted today
screens.purpose: E6 · Daily limit. The one-vote-a-day rule made friendly: countdown to the next vote, the streak at stake, share instead, and cooks to follow.

screens.name: Find a cook
screens.purpose: E8 · Search, reached from the magnifier on A1 and on the feed. One field covers name, dish and area, and each row says which of the three matched, so someone sent a name on WhatsApp can find her without knowing her club or her rank. Vote straight from the result.

screens.name: My supporter profile
screens.purpose: E7 · Supporter profile. Streak, badges, the votes her shares actually produced, and raffle entries. The voter-side identity Phase 2 inherits.

screens.name: Club leaderboard
screens.purpose: F1 · Club leaderboard. Podium, ranked list with movement arrows, a close-race band between second and third, and the note that judges and tasting stay sealed.

screens.name: Club vs club
screens.purpose: F2 · Club vs club. Five clubs by total participation with your club pinned, and one share to push it up the city table.

links.label: Help Shooting Club lead the city

screens.name: Table QR landing
screens.purpose: G1 · Table QR. One dish, one giant button, one rule stated before the button: taste everything first.
screens.entry_point: QR code on the table at the tasting event

screens.name: Live vote confirmed
screens.purpose: G2 · Live vote in. What the vote is worth, how many of the 340 guests have voted, and when results are announced.

screens.name: Big screen live board
screens.purpose: G3 · Big screen. Landscape board for the TV at the club: live tasting counts, sponsor lockup and the countdown to the reveal.
screens.entry_point: opened on the room screen by the host, nobody taps into it
screens.not_in_demo_because: Room screen for the live event, 1280x720, shown on a TV. Out of scope for the phone demo.

screens.name: Results reveal
screens.purpose: H1 · Results. Third, second, then the winner, each opened up into judges, tasting and online so the blend is visible rather than asserted.

screens.name: Winner page
screens.purpose: H2 · Winner page. A permanent profile badge, the final score, the Grand Final line and a follow button that carries into Phase 2.

screens.name: Thank you, competitors
screens.purpose: H3 · Every competitor. Verified eCook badge, personal stats, and the nudge to finish the kitchen profile before orders open.

screens.name: Voter wrap-up
screens.purpose: H4 · Voter wrap-up. Season stats, raffle result, follow your favourites, and the teaser for the next club edition.

screens.name: Two title tracks
screens.purpose: J1 · Two tracks, run at once. Your area is open to everyone and carries dish, category and area titles; your club is optional and members-only. Both feed the city title, with Hoda as the worked example and the scarcity rule underneath.

screens.name: Titles in your area
screens.purpose: J2 · Area board. Titles held now with their holder and how long they have held them, then the locked ones. A locked title is a recruitment ask: invite two more molokhia cooks and it opens.

screens.name: Titled cook profile
screens.purpose: J3 · The status asset. Titles sit under her name on the same creator profile from E2, with a held-since line each. This is what carries into Phase 2 when her kitchen opens.

links.label: One of her titles is challenged

screens.name: Your title is challenged
screens.purpose: J4 · The months-long engine. Eight votes apart with three days left brings a holder back to share again, and gives the challenger a scalp worth taking.

screens.name: Title awarded
screens.purpose: J5 · Hoda takes #1 Cook in Dokki while finishing second overall. Titles spread the winning around, which is what keeps thirteen of fourteen cooks playing.
screens.entry_point: arrives as a push or WhatsApp notification

screens.name: Sponsor event report
screens.purpose: FLOW I · Sponsor report (desktop). KPI row, votes per day, shares by channel, featured entries, photo highlights, and the payoff from the location data: voters and cooks per area, which is where the supply gap becomes visible.
screens.entry_point: private link sent to the sponsor, desktop width
screens.not_in_demo_because: Sponsor report, desktop width, sent as a private link. Out of scope for the phone demo.

screens.name: Home, Arabic
screens.purpose: AR1 · The home screen in Arabic. Not a translation of A1: the layout is mirrored, Arabic is the primary line and English is demoted, and the display face is Cairo because Instrument Serif has no Arabic. Note what moved: the back and next arrows point the other way, the rank number sits on the right of each row, the movement arrow on the left, and the carousel swipes the other way.
screens.not_in_demo_because: Arabic mirroring reference for A1. Arabic is a toggle on every screen, not a separate screen.

links.label: Sign up as a cook to compete

screens.name: Signup step 2, Arabic
screens.purpose: AR2 · The hardest screen to mirror, which is why it is here: a floated field label, a map with an overlaid accuracy chip, a photo avatar with a corner badge, and a sticky action bar. Every one of those hard-codes a side in the English build.

screens.name: Feed, Arabic
screens.purpose: AR3 · The feed in Arabic, with the story text in Egyptian Arabic rather than a translation of the English. The vote button, follow and share keep their order relative to the reading direction, so the primary action still lands under the thumb.

screens.name: Posts and profiles
screens.purpose: K1 · The reusable pieces: entry post, creator profile header, vote and follow states, rank badges and avatar sizes, built so Phase 2 inherits them.
screens.not_in_demo_because: Component sheet. Build the components from it, do not build it as a page.

screens.name: Foundations
screens.purpose: K2 · Foundations: colour with the contrast decisions written down, type across three families, the icon set and the five engagement patterns.
screens.not_in_demo_because: Foundations sheet: colour, type, icons, engagement patterns.

screens.name: Empty, error and losing states
screens.purpose: K3 · The states the happy path hides, and every one happens in week one: nobody matches the search, you are the first cook in your area, location is denied, the code is wrong, the photo upload dies, voting has closed, the phone is offline, and the cook sitting at #12 of 14. The losing-cook panel carries the rule: below 5th place, never show the gap to the leader.
screens.not_in_demo_because: States catalogue. Every state in it must be implemented inside its own screen.

screens.name: Screen map
screens.purpose: Not a screen. The routing table, generated from the other artboards.
screens.not_in_demo_because: The screen map. A document, not a screen.
